name: Pealzero
description: Seats the stock in the shoulder with the barrel angled a hair toward the partner's line so that both rifles meet at one point.

name: Bedrock Bipod
description: Advances in two parallel lanes a short distance apart, each rifleman watching the ground the other cannot see.

name: Bedrock Rifling
description: Drops behind the nearest cover with the muzzle toward the foe and the partner's flank covered by the shoulder.

name: Chamber Triumph
description: Loads in mirror time with the partner, one loading while the other aims, with qi in the hands keeping the beat.

name: Seasonscope
description: Lays two lines of fire in front of a moving enemy so that his path ahead is closed on either side.

name: Buttpad Troth
description: Knocks a blow aside with one barrel while the partner's rifle covers the opening it makes.

name: Reminiscence Bolt
description: Calls the distance to the target in a short hawk-like cry so the partner sets his sight without taking his eye off the mark.

name: Imperial Buttpad
description: Fires in the same instant as the partner at the same plate, doubling the force at one point of a guard.

name: Vigor Muzzlebrake
description: Withdraws by turns, one rifleman firing from a halt while the other falls back to the next cover.

name: Lordly Sight
description: Joins two fields in a held pair aim and splits the guard of a plated foe with a single shared shot.

name: Dauntless Steel Zero
description: The school's pair-fire: two riflemen hold one line in joined qi and send their shots down it as if from one barrel.

name: Rearsight Decree
description: Settles the forestock on the first rest and the elbow on the second until the barrel stops moving.

name: Pealbolt
description: Holds a hand's shade over the sights against the bright Azure Sky to keep the bead clear.

name: Magazine Voyage
description: Steps sideways into the partner's vacated lane as he moves, so the firing line never leaves a gap.

name: Venombreath
description: Fires on the held beat of an opponent's qi to break the rhythm of the technique he was building.

name: Unrivaled Breath
description: Holds a loaded and aimed rifle on both rests until the partner's signal, then looses it on the call.

name: Boltseal
description: Fires and withdraws along a line of shade so that the enemy's eye follows the smoke and not the shooter.

name: Marrowfire Buttpad
description: Crosses the rifles of the pair in front of the two bodies to take a heavy blow on joined iron.

name: Pulsar Chamber
description: Holds a shared aim through a long pause and looses both shots together to bore through a defender's qi guard.

name: Noble Rearsight
description: Gathers both shooters' fields into one heavy ball sent in a single shot that splits plate and guard together.

name: Unrivaled Rifling
description: The school's closing fire: two riflemen trade shots in a fixed pattern until the enemy's ground is fully shut.

name: Peal Buttpad
description: Lies on a basin slope with the forestock on a ridge of earth that the enemy's eye reads as shadow.

name: Bountiful Rifling
description: Paces the river bank beside a ford and fixes the width of the water for the shots to follow.

name: Silken Scopemount
description: Steps along the rim edge a hand below the skyline so that no shape shows against the sky.

name: Statute Buttpad
description: Crouches in a reed stand with the rifle held flat across the thighs so that the stems close above.

name: Tyrannous Rearsight
description: Fires into a hollow of the basin so the echo returns from three rims and the enemy cannot place the shooter.

name: Pulsar Muzzlebrake
description: Sets qi to the river's slow pace so the aim rises and falls with it and the shot lands at the still point.

name: Millstone Zero
description: Fires from two ridges toward the floor between them so that anyone crossing it is caught in two lines.

name: Zero Heraldry
description: Dashes sideways along the shingle with qi in the calves, the rifle level and the sights on the mark.

name: Millstone Scopemount
description: Crosses the line of shot over a river bend so that a boat or column in the bend is struck from two angles.

name: Tenetscope
description: Fires from a ridge crest, rolls down the reverse slope and fires again from the next crest before the enemy turns.

name: Peerless Breath
description: Looses a single heavy shot down the mouth of the basin on a held aim that bores through armour and guard.

name: Heroic Millstone Sight
description: The school's unbroken line: shot after shot walked down the length of a basin floor with qi linking each to the last.

name: Interstice Muzzlebrake
description: Checks that both barrels in the pair lie level and point at the same mark before the first shot.

name: Feather Zero
description: Climbs a steep slope in tandem, each man's boots placing stone for the next and each rifle kept clear of rock.

name: Scopebanner
description: Opens the elbows like wings and sets the feet wide to hold the rifle steady against a hard recoil.

name: Squall Scopemount
description: Runs the loading hand on one track of qi and the aiming hand on another so that neither interrupts the other.

name: Delugescope
description: Lets a blow strike the barrel and rebound into a return stroke with the stock against the attacker's elbow.

name: Breathvow
description: Retreats under the shadow of a passing cloud so that the shooter's outline blends with the dark patch on the ground.

name: Ruling Zero
description: Fires both muzzles in a blaze of flash at the face of an opponent who is gathering a technique.

name: Bipodedict
description: Alternates the firing of two rifles in a steady drum so the enemy never finds a silent moment to advance.

name: Longshot Triumph
description: Holds a high aim and lets the shot fall on the weak seam of an armoured foe like a diving hawk.

name: Splendid Buttpad
description: Weds the fields of two barrels in a single held aim and breaks a guard with the doubled shot.

name: Pulsar Cheekrest
description: The school's highest pair-shot: both barrels loosed in a single breath with a single will behind them.

name: Interstice Chamber
description: Runs a quick check of stock, sling and rest to confirm both qi tracks have somewhere to sit.

name: Ethereal Muzzlebrake
description: Moves from perch to perch in one hop with the field flaring outward to cushion the landing.

name: Fearless Sight
description: Holds a clear mountain-style breath at the top of the lungs while the field settles round the barrel.

name: Pulsarzero
description: Links the field to the barrel's qi in one thread so that the ball leaves already steered.

name: Despotic Rifling
description: Draws basin mist around the firing place with the field so the shooter's shape dissolves from sight.

name: Pall Rearsight
description: Turns a blade aside on the field's second track and the barrel's first, the two together taking its force.

name: Bipod Crown
description: Fires a burst of aimed shots in an even rhythm while the field covers every motion, pinning a squad behind its wall.

name: Prism Muzzlebrake
description: Looses a downward shot on a held field aim so that the ball bites through a guard at the end of its fall.

name: Dauntless Bolt
description: Sends a shot on the joined tracks of field and barrel that splits plate and the qi guard beneath it.

name: Storied Pulsar Bipod
description: The school's long shot: field, barrel and perch drawn into one held aim and released as a single stoop.

name: Buttpad Banner
description: Anchors the stock in the shoulder and lets the warmth of the Core run steady down both arms.

name: Merciful Chamber
description: Reads the pulse of the Core against the weight of the rifle to tell when the body is fit to shoot.

name: Ethereal Rifling
description: Takes two quick paired steps, left then right, that leave the rifle level and the stance reset.

name: Consecrated Muzzlebrake
description: Crouches behind cover with the Core's warmth gathered in the back and shoulders against jarring shock.

name: Pealscope
description: Feeds both tracks of qi from the Core so that aim and drive never starve one another.

name: Ruling Bipod
description: Throws the report across the basin on a pulse from the Core and hangs a veil of smoke between shooter and foe.

name: Boltpledge
description: Pulses the Core outward with the shot so that the enemy's qi stumbles in its circuit for one breath.

name: Squallbipod
description: Lifts the body on a pulse from the Core into a long backward bound that keeps the rifle on the foe.

name: Radiance Reticle
description: Throws a burst of Core qi into the shot at the moment of firing so that the ball bores through.

name: Matchless Squeeze
description: Sustains an even rolling fire from a high place with the Core feeding every reload and aim.

name: Vacuumbolt
description: Draws the Core to a single point at the muzzle and sends a long shot that holds its line and splits a guard.

name: Boltcrown
description: The school's crowning shot: Core, field and sight drawn into one point and loosed as a single piercing stroke.
